name: Huebner Berry Patch and Fruit Farm
description: Huebner Berry Patch and Fruit Farm is a working farm in Normangee, TX. It grows Blackberries, Peaches, Nectarines, Plums, and Grapes, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
